newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nokia started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nokia started as buy.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd said on Monday it initiated coverage of Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of 450 Finnish markka.

-- Analyst Sean Faughnan said in a research note he forecast revenue growth at Nokia Telecommunications would grow by 29 percent per year in 1997 and 1998, although margins should decline gradually as competition increases.

-- He said Nokia's management had significantly improved handset profitability over the last three quarters, and the division was well-placed to benefit from very high digital growth anticipated in 1997.
-- Nokia's shares had further upside potential even after their recent outperformance, he said.
-- Nokia's stock was up 1.70 at 392 markka in Helsinki, and its ADR (American Depository Receipt) was off 14/16 at 74-7/16 on the New York Stock Exchange.
